objective: Implement and mechanically validate a name-independent compiler-backed object/context identity and provenance interface over the exposed D1P-42 Step 6a controls, without performing an authorization check or creating a security conclusion.

execution_boundary.allowed: Mechanical schema, compiler/ABI/AST provenance, deterministic hashes, mapping certificates, name-influence quarantine, source-preserving transformation controls, and synthetic negative identity/context swaps over exposed material only.

public_interface.semantic_hash_domain: Canonical logical object plus canonical execution context only.
public_interface.separate_provenance_domain: Compiler/language/version, artifact hash/schema, AST node or ABI index, mapping ID, source hash/span, derivation class, assumptions, annotations, support/reason, and display hints.

identity_model.fact_identity_ref_representation: Both subject_identity_ref and object_identity_ref use the exact opaque three-field identity reference, never the truncated semantic hash alone.

condition_boundary.step_8: Canonical structured extraction JSON with a mandatory nonempty kind; no authorization interpretation.
condition_boundary.step_9: The authorization boundary applies its stricter allowlist ALWAYS, NEVER, UNKNOWN, or PREDICATE and returns UNKNOWN for unsupported conditions.

reference_resolution_boundary.provenance_refs: Must resolve to an identity provenance hash inside the bundle or an explicit external: namespace.
reference_resolution_boundary.parent_fact_ids: Must resolve to another fact in the same bundle or an explicit external: namespace.
reference_resolution_boundary.assumption_refs: Resolved only through a separate hash-bound external inventory.
reference_resolution_boundary.annotation_refs: Resolved only through a separate hash-bound external inventory.
reference_resolution_boundary.mapping_refs: Resolved only through the input manifest's hash-bound external mapping inventory.

identity_model.mapping_reference_rule: Mapping entries carry exact opaque from/to identity refs. Certificates require unique source refs/indices for totality, unique target refs/indices for injectivity/surjectivity, exhaustive bundle binding during replay, and mapping_source_refs linked through the external inventory.

fixture_annotation.provenance: Explicitly authored from the exposed Step 6a D1P-42 mapping records before the D2-08 run.
fixture_annotation.claim_limit: This annotation is not independently reviewed policy and cannot support an automatic semantic-recovery or authorization claim.

name_influence_audit.rule: The public role-binding entry point must contain no symbol references or calls to canonical_role, semantic_identity, or the quarantined legacy analyzer.

required: matched public-input reordering with explicit mapping
transformation_controls.acceptance: For each transformation, compiler artifacts and source/mapping hashes verify, the mapping is total/injective/surjective, and corresponding logical slots retain the same semantic identity hash.
transformation_controls.order_rule: The first three mappings are order-preserving; matched reorder is intentionally not order-preserving and must preserve semantic identity through its explicit bijection.
transformation_controls.claim_limit: The Step 6a source argument and focused build/execution/algebra controls plus this identity mapping are bounded fixture controls, not formal or general semantic-equivalence proof.

step_9_interface_coordination.consumes: IdentityBundle, IdentityFact, and the exact opaque identity reference
step_9_interface_coordination.rule: The P/O/E boundary may not consume display labels, source locations, or legacy semantic tokens. UNREVIEWED_DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE keeps the effective result UNKNOWN.

step_10_extraction_coordination.required: Separate object/context identities; typed facts with MUST/MAY and approximation; compiler/artifact/node-or-ABI provenance; parent/assumption/annotation/mapping references; first-class mapping certificates.
step_10_extraction_coordination.rule: Current role labels and semantic tokens are annotations only.

resource_budget.human_minutes_reason: No independently timed human session; zero is not imputed.

completion_criteria: public security conclusion path is fail-closed against name-derived roles
identity and provenance hashes replay deterministically
all external annotation, mapping, assumption, parent, and provenance references resolve through the explicit input inventory
all four bounded Step 6a transformation mappings pass their declared properties
three negative object/context fixtures and two controls match known answers
Step 9 and Step 10 consume stable versioned symbols without display labels
fresh raw namespace is checksum-complete, sealed, and independently verifies
no score, security verdict, formal/general proof, or reserved data access occurs
claim_limits: Compiler/ABI provenance does not itself establish semantic policy, authorization, or object authenticity.
The logical slot map is an annotation, not automatic semantic recovery.
No stable Noir SSA identifier is claimed when the artifact does not expose one.
No current novelty, capability, generality, transfer, or security claim follows.
